title: World Bank Human Capital Project
definition: A global accelerated effort by the World Bank launched in 2018 to bolster investments in people through health, education, and social protection to build human capital and eliminate extreme poverty.
importanceInUpsc: Directly relevant for GS Paper III (Economy - Human Development, Inclusive Growth, Poverty & Employment) and Prelims (International Organizations, Global Indices like Human Capital Index).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of World Bank Human Capital Project.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of economic development, human resource development, and inclusive growth.
